title: M1-M6 Method Screening Round-1 (mini screening, quick elimination)
paper_stage: 方法改善阶段 -> 多候选快速海选（非最终方法证明）
question: M1-M6 中哪些方法有希望比现有 baseline 更好地改善 robustness-preservation trade-off？

frozen_protocol.baseline_pipeline: experiment5a_h_runner.run_config (bank / coreset 0.1 / kNN 9 / illumination / scoring / per_image.csv)

primary_metrics.preservation: mean defect d-prime (higher better, frozen 5A-H 口径)

criteria.note: EPS_DP = 5A-H 冻结 preservation band; EPS_RZ = 7A-O Tier-A 冻结 robustness band

frozen_protocol.no_param_search: k=16 / lambda=0.5 / alpha'=0.40091275 全部冻结，无 grid search

M1_illum_standard.definition: x' = (x - mu_c(x)) * (sigma_ref_c / sigma_c(x)) + mu_ref_c, per-image per-channel, applied identically to train/val/clean test/defect/shifted
M1_illum_standard.reference_stats_source: train normal only (189/204 imgs, resize 256, [0,1] space)

M2_dual_concat_B1_g100.note: 0 GPU: raw 分数直接重组；15/15 full panel 作为 supplementary

M3_nuis_k16.definition: F' = F - U_k U_k^T F per layer, U_k from train-normal clean-vs-shift feature difference covariance top-k eigenvectors (pooled pre-concat space)
M3_nuis_k16.basis_source: train normal only; illumination perturbations = the 4 frozen shifts

M4_residual_compensation.definition: F_r = (1-a')F + a' IN(F); F_out = F_r + lambda(F - F_r) == (1-a)F + a IN(F), a=(1-lambda)a'

M5_selective_bypass.reason: 只有 oracle channel selection，无公平 lightweight deterministic rule；本轮不实现、不发明 heuristic

M6_channel_selective.note: ORACLE（selection 用 test defect mask），不是 deployable 方法；0 GPU

m4diag.purpose: 同一配置重复运行 -> 检验管线确定性（用于归因 M4 score 级差异）

execution.model: scripts/experiment9a_model.py (M1/M3/M4 模型定义，未修改任何历史实验代码)
